findings.summary: The experiment branch changes driver-first greedy body ownership to global Hungarian assignment under a refactoring label.
Initialized hand slots for disappeared owners may stop receiving misses, retain retired anchors, and prevent face-id reuse.
The private header exposes the complete face/body/hand execution script instead of stable phase-level contracts.
AssignmentResult, HandSlotKey, and HandAssignmentRow are solver or single-frame transport details that leak into header scope.
Finalize-before-publish side-effect separation is worth preserving, but it should be hidden inside deeper phase-level methods.
